QuestInfo.name: Porchay's Request 3
QuestInfo.0: Even without the Lorangs and the Clangs, there are plenty of monsters on the beach.
QuestInfo.1: Now take care of the #b#o4130101#s#k. The whole crew of the Nautilus is cheering you on! Maybe!
QuestInfo.2: You beat those #b#o4130101#s#k right out of their shells.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 6,379 Can proceed to the Guardian of the Sea quest

0.0: #h0#, you've made a huge difference here in Florina Beach. Everywhere I look, the people are happy and safe and un-pinched. \r\n
0.1: I would ask that you continue your work, though, and eliminate the #b#o4130101#s#k living on the beach. They're not so dangerous...they just take all the best sunbathing spots.

yes.0: I knew you would help us out. As before, clearing around #b50#k #b#o4130101#s#k should be enough. I almost feel bad about this, but they should have known better than to take all the best sunbathing spots. They were asking for it, really.

no.0: But, this is for the people! It's for their right to sunbathe wherever they choose!

1.0: Wow! Florina Beach looks totally different without all those lazy Torties hurting the property value. Good job, #h0#.

mob.0: I still see too many Torties on the beach for my tastes. We need at least 50 of them gone.
